identity.kind: bundle of business/self-help paperback books (assorted titles)

claims.claim: Get 5 copies of good books for 20k & 10 copies for 33k
claims.evidence: No photo shows per-unit condition, page count, or whether 'copies' means 5 of the same title or 5 different titles; pricing itself is not something photos can confirm.
Only spines are shown; no interior page or print-quality photo to confirm 'good' condition or that these are genuine (non-pirated) editions.
Marketing phrase, not a verifiable product claim.

risks.risk: Books may be photocopied/pirated editions rather than original publisher copies, common for cheap bulk bestseller bundles in this market.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of a printed page showing publisher's imprint page, ISBN barcode, and print quality/font sharpness.
risks.if_unproven: priced as low-grade/possibly pirated copies, not original retail editions

risks.risk: Physical condition of pages (dog-eared corners, highlighting, missing pages, water damage) cannot be judged from spine-only shots.
risks.proof: Photos of open book interiors (a few random pages) and front/back covers for each title or at least a sample.

risks.risk: Ambiguity on what '5 copies' and '10 copies' actually means — one copy each of 5 different titles, or 5 copies of a single title — affects what the buyer actually receives for the price.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation message or photo showing the exact book list included in each bundle tier.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming the buyer receives only the minimum interpretation (5 or 10 lowest-value titles, mixed/used)

risks.risk: Completeness of the set — all 10 titles may not be included in the lower-tier bundle, no breakdown given.
risks.proof: Seller itemized list matching bundle tier to specific titles.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of an open interior page for at least 2–3 titles showing print quality and publisher imprint page/ISBN.
Photo of front and back covers of each book (not just spines).
Clarification with a photo/text list of which exact titles are included in the 5-copy and 10-copy bundles.
response.reason: The titles are legible and identifiable by type/title from the photos, but condition, authenticity (possible photocopy/pirated print), and exact bundle contents are unverifiable from spine-only shots, so the bundle must be priced at worst case (possibly pirated, used condition) until interior/cover photos and a bundle breakdown are provided.
